verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a manual-evidence path: you can attach an evidence file to a document and submit it for review, upload documents automatically, and assign owners to resources and controls. Nothing in the pack shows due dates, renewal reminders, or expiry tracking on manual artifacts. The only reminder claim is about risk assessments, which is a different story. Missing for 10: due dates on manual evidence, renewal reminders, expiry tracking, explicit per-document ownership, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact

citations.quote: Attach an evidence file to a Vanta document and submit it for review, using the Manage Vanta API.
automatically upload documents or policies, bulk assign owners to resources or mark them out of scope
Make a specific Vanta user accountable for a framework control's compliance status
